model.title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 189 East Main Street in Xenia, Ohio, as the "Gilman 'Gil' Whitney Post Office Building".
model.meta: Oversight and Government Reform Committee · Rep. Michael Turner (R-OH)

summary.text: The bill would rename the U.S. Postal Service facility at 189 East Main Street in Xenia, Ohio, to honor it as the "Gilman 'Gil' Whitney Post Office Building."
